project_type: Legacy Fortran 77/fixed-form CFD solver (SIMPLE algorithm, enthalpy-porosity laser melting model). The AMMAN repo is otherwise a manuscript/document repo (Python docx generators, markdown chapters); the Fortran solver is a new, self-contained addition unrelated to the rest of the repo.
language: Fortran (fixed-form, legacy). Uses IMPLICIT DOUBLE PRECISION, COMMON blocks, EQUIVALENCE, ENTRY statements, computed-style GOTO/IF, INCLUDE of PARAM.FOR and COMMON.FOR.
build_system: Direct gfortran invocation. No Makefile. gfortran 11.5.0 is preinstalled at /usr/bin/gfortran.
test_framework: None. Verification is a clean compile only (per orchestrator: acceptance == clean compile). There is no runtime test harness and no input data files in-repo.
build_command: cd /projects/sandbox/AMMAN/laser_melting && gfortran -std=legacy -ffixed-line-length-132 -o laser_melt laser_melt.f  (adjust flags empirically; -fno-automatic and -w may help; goal is a clean object/exe build with no errors)
test_command: Same as build_command. A clean compile (exit 0, no error diagnostics) is the acceptance criterion. Warnings are acceptable but should be minimized.
verification_instructions: 1) Run the gfortran compile command above. 2) Confirm exit code 0 and that laser_melt executable is produced with no ERROR diagnostics. 3) Confirm the file contains exactly one PROGRAM MAIN and one copy of each named SUBROUTINE, with PARAM.FOR PARAMETER line inlined immediately before each inlined COMMON.FOR block in every routine that originally had INCLUDE 'PARAM.FOR'/INCLUDE 'COMMON.FOR'. 4) Confirm no INCLUDE statements remain. 5) Confirm no PAUSE statements remain (converted to WRITE). 6) Confirm GETDAT/GETTIM are gone (ported to DATE_AND_TIME).
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. The compiled executable and .o files should NOT be committed (add them to .gitignore or leave uncommitted).
setup_instructions: No setup needed. gfortran 11.5.0, gcc, make all preinstalled. Work on branch add-laser-melting-fortran. New file goes at AMMAN/laser_melting/laser_melt.f.
environment_constraints: Network mode restricted; gfortran already installed so no package install needed. Cannot push or open PRs (orchestrator handles that). No em dashes in written content.
contribution_requirements: Preserve numerical behavior and physics EXACTLY. Do not invent physics or change any constant. Only permitted transformations: (a) inline PARAM.FOR + COMMON.FOR in place of INCLUDE, (b) port GETDAT/GETTIM to DATE_AND_TIME, (c) convert diagnostic PAUSE to non-halting WRITE, (d) fix fixed-form column/tab/continuation issues so it compiles.
key_patterns: COMMON.FOR (verbatim, provided in user_instruction) defines all COMMON blocks BLK01..BLK16 plus DIMENSION/EQUIVALENCE for U,V,PC,P,UOLD,VOLD,COF/COFU/COFV/COFP,TH aliases. PARAM.FOR (verbatim): PARAMETER(NI=242,NJ=242,NIJ=242,NFMAX=39,NFX3=NFMAX+3,NZMAX=152). PARAM line must precede COMMON block in EACH routine so NI/NJ/etc. are defined before use. Fixed-form: continuation char in column 6, code starts column 7, labels in columns 1-5. Original used tabs; must produce valid fixed-form that gfortran -std=legacy accepts.
relevant_files: orchestrator_briefing (contains the per-routine specification: every ENTRY, OPEN unit, FORMAT label, numeric constant, and behavior)
directory_structure: New subdir AMMAN/laser_melting/ holds laser_melt.f. Rest of repo is documents/manuscripts unrelated to this task.
source_availability_note: IMPORTANT: The literal character-level 'pasted listing' referenced by the briefing is NOT present verbatim in the delegated context for the routine BODIES. What IS verbatim: COMMON.FOR and PARAM.FOR (in user_instruction). Everything else (PROGRAM MAIN and all subroutines/entries) is provided as a highly detailed behavioral+constant specification in the orchestrator_briefing. The coder must implement each routine body faithfully to that specification using standard fixed-form Fortran that compiles cleanly under gfortran -std=legacy, honoring every named constant, OPEN unit+filename, FORMAT label, ENTRY, EQUIVALENCE, and COMMON usage. Do NOT invent additional physics. Where the spec is explicit (constants, units, filenames), reproduce exactly.
